import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Load the data
data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(12, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# Plot 1: Survival by Sex
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_by_sex.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax1, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax1.set_title('Survival by Sex')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sex')
ax1.set_ylabel('Count')
ax1.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
ax1.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 2: Survival by Class
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
survival_by_class = df.groupby('class')['survived'].value_counts().unstack(fill_value=0)
class_order = ['First', 'Third']
survival_by_class = survival_by_class.reindex([c for c in class_order if c in survival_by_class.index])
survival_by_class.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax2, color=['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71'])
ax2.set_title('Survival by Class')
ax2.set_xlabel('Class')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count')
ax2.legend(['Did not survive', 'Survived'])
ax2.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=0)

# Plot 3: Age Distribution by Survival
ax3 = axes[1, 0]
colors = ['#e74c3c', '#2ecc71']
for i, survived in enumerate([0, 1]):
    subset = df[df['survived'] == survived]['age'].dropna()
    label = 'Survived' if survived == 1 else 'Did not survive'
    ax3.hist(subset, bins=10, alpha=0.7, label=label, color=colors[i])
ax3.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
ax3.set_xlabel('Age')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count')
ax3.legend()

# Plot 4: Fare by Class and Survival
ax4 = axes[1, 1]
sns.scatterplot(data=df, x='age', y='fare', hue='survived', style='class', 
                palette={0: '#e74c3c', 1: '#2ecc71'}, s=100, ax=ax4)
ax4.set_title('Fare vs Age (by Survival and Class)')
ax4.set_xlabel('Age')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare')
handles, labels = ax4.get_legend_handles_labels()
new_labels = ['Did not survive' if l == '0' else 'Survived' if l == '1' else l for l in labels]
ax4.legend(handles, new_labels, loc='upper right')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight')
